import numpy as np

W_Q = W["blocks.0.attn.W_Q"]
W_K = W["blocks.0.attn.W_K"]
W_V = W["blocks.0.attn.W_V"]
W_O = W["blocks.0.attn.W_O"]
b_Q = W.get("blocks.0.attn.b_Q", np.zeros((4,6)))
b_K = W.get("blocks.0.attn.b_K", np.zeros((4,6)))
b_V = W.get("blocks.0.attn.b_V", np.zeros((4,6)))
W_E = W["embed.W_E"]
W_pos = W["pos_embed.W_pos"]
d_head = 6

def head0_write(tokens):
    x = np.array([W_E[t] + W_pos[p] for p, t in enumerate(tokens)])
    Q = x @ W_Q[0] + b_Q[0]
    K = x @ W_K[0] + b_K[0]
    V = x @ W_V[0] + b_V[0]
    scores = Q @ K.T / np.sqrt(d_head)
    a = np.exp(scores - scores.max(-1, keepdims=True))
    a /= a.sum(-1, keepdims=True)
    return (a @ V) @ W_O[0], a

all1 = [11,1,1,1,1,1,1,1,1,1]
all5 = [11,5,5,5,5,5,5,5,5,5]
w1, a1 = head0_write(all1)
w5, a5 = head0_write(all5)

# INDICATOR: varies by position, not token
print("Attn pattern head0 (all-1s):")
for i in range(10): print(f"  pos{i}: {a1[i].round(2)}")

print("\nWrite norms (all-1s):", np.linalg.norm(w1, axis=-1).round(3))
print("Write norms (all-5s):", np.linalg.norm(w5, axis=-1).round(3))

# Key comparison: position-based vs token-based variation

t1_t5 = np.dot(w1[1], w5[1])/(np.linalg.norm(w1[1])*np.linalg.norm(w5[1])+1e-10)
print(f"\nCos-sim pos1 vs pos6 (same token=1): {p1_p6:.3f}  (low = position-sensitive = INDICATOR)")
print(f"Cos-sim tok1 vs tok5 (same pos=1):  {t1_t5:.3f}  (low = token-sensitive = MAPPER/ROUTER)")
